analysis_result.analysis: The model fundamentally misunderstood the cube structure and visibility constraints. Instead of recognizing that each cube has six uniquely colored faces and only three are hidden (IN, LEFT, UP), it assumed monochromatic cubes and miscounted hidden faces by multiplying frame counts. This led to a completely incorrect color frequency distribution (yellow = 15) versus the correct one (purple = 4). The error stems from misperceiving object attributes and spatial configuration, cascading into flawed reasoning and counting.
